backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Person, Achievement, Event, LockerBill, EquipmentItem, LockerDocument, DriveLink, UserProfile) and implementing CRUD operations with role-based access control (admin/user permissions) and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: renaming the application from 'Baja Club Hub' to 'VVCEBAJA' and replacing footer text with '#BuiltBeyondBounds', both with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend components including modals for adding documents/photos/links/bills/equipment/team members, card components for displaying data, hooks for React Query operations, and updated branding to 'VVCEBAJA' with motorsports-themed styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining motorsports-inspired theme variables (racing red, carbon black, metallic silver, safety orange, championship gold) for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title set to 'VVCEBAJA' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, team, achievements, events, and protected member locker sections, wrapped in ThemeProvider with dark mode default.
Card component displaying achievement details with image, title, date, description, and admin-only delete functionality using React Query mutation.
frontend/src/components/AddAchievementMo: Modal dialog for adding achievements with form inputs for title, date, description, and multiple image uploads with progress tracking using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/AddBillModal.tsx: Modal dialog for uploading bills with fields for title, amount, date, comments, and an image file. Handles file upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob and integrates with useAddBill hook.
frontend/src/components/AddDocumentModal: Modal dialog for uploading documents with fields for title, description, tags, and file attachment. Supports file upload with progress tracking and uses useAddDocument hook for backend integration.
frontend/src/components/AddDriveLinkModa: Modal dialog for adding external drive links with URL validation, title, and description fields. Uses useAddDriveLink hook to save links without file uploads.
frontend/src/components/AddEquipmentModa: Modal dialog for adding equipment inventory with fields for name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, description, comments, and image. Includes upload progress tracking and uses useAddEquipment hook.
frontend/src/components/AddEventModal.ts: Modal dialog for creating events with title, date, location, description, and multiple image uploads. Supports batch image upload with progress tracking using ExternalBlob and useAddEvent hook.
frontend/src/components/AddPhotoModal.ts: Modal dialog for uploading multiple photo files with progress tracking, using ExternalBlob for file handling and displaying upload percentage.
frontend/src/components/AddTeamMemberMod: Modal dialog for adding team members with name, Principal ID, role, contact info, and image upload fields with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/BillCard.tsx: Card component displaying bill details (title, amount, date, author) with download and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/DocumentCard.tsx: Card component for displaying document metadata (title, description, tags, date, author) with download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DriveLinkCard.ts: Card component showing external drive link information with open link button and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/EquipmentCard.ts: Card component displaying equipment item details (image, name, quantity, price, purchase date) with admin-only delete option.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Card component for events showing date, title, location, description, and optional images with admin-only delete for non-past events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header containing logo, desktop/mobile navigation, login button, and footer. Includes responsive mobile menu toggle and navigation links for Home, Our Team, Achievements, Events, and Member Locker.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between Login/Logout states using Internet Identity. Handles login errors, clears query cache on logout, and displays loading spinner during authentication.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Grid-based photo gallery component that displays locker documents sorted by upload date. Opens a lightbox modal when photos are clicked.
frontend/src/components/PhotoLightbox.ts: Full-screen photo viewer with keyboard navigation (arrows, escape), download functionality, and admin-only delete capability. Displays photo metadata and navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name. Prevents dismissal until profile is created and saves profile with join date.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that shows loading state during initialization and displays a login prompt for unauthenticated users. Renders children only when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Card component displaying team member details (image, name, role, contact) with admin-only delete functionality. Handles member removal via Principal-based identification.
frontend/src/components/UpcomingEventsPr: Displays the next 3 upcoming events in a compact card format with date, title, description, and location. Shows loading state and hides when no upcoming events exist.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: React Query hooks for managing achievements: fetching all achievements, adding, updating by title, and removing achievements. Invalidates cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control with admin token from URL params. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing events: fetching all events, adding, updating, and removing events via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication with React context, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerBills.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker bills: fetching all bills, adding new bills, and deleting bills via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDocuments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing locker documents: fetching all documents, adding new documents, and deleting documents via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDriveLinks.t: Provides React Query hooks for managing drive links: fetching all drive links, adding new links, and deleting links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerEquipment.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing equipment items: fetching all equipment, adding new equipment, and deleting equipment via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for admin checks, user profiles, team members, achievements, and all locker-related data (bills, equipment, documents, drive links).
frontend/src/hooks/useTeamMembers.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing team members: fetching all people, adding, updating, and removing person records via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes using a motorsports-inspired color palette (racing red, carbon black, metallic silver, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutTeam.tsx: Displays team members in a grid layout with admin controls to add/edit/remove members, showing loading states and empty states appropriately.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Displays a grid of achievement cards sorted by date, with admin controls to add new achievements via a modal. Shows loading state and empty state with prompts to add the first achievement.
frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx: Displays events split into upcoming and past sections, sorted by date, with admin controls to add new events. Includes loading and empty states with calendar icon.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with hero section featuring team branding and navigation cards linking to team, achievements, events, and member locker sections. Includes upcoming events preview component.
frontend/src/pages/LockerBills.tsx: Displays financial bills in a grid sorted by date with add bill functionality. Includes back navigation to member locker and empty state prompts.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDocuments.tsx: Shows team documents in a grid with search functionality filtering by title, description, or tags. Includes upload document modal and back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDriveLinks.tsx: Displays external storage drive links in a grid sorted by date added, with add link modal and back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerEquipment.tsx: Shows equipment inventory in a grid sorted by purchase date, with add equipment modal and back navigation to member locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerPhotos.tsx: React page component that displays a photo gallery filtered from locker documents tagged as 'photo' or 'image', with upload functionality via AddPhotoModal and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/MemberLocker.tsx: React page component that renders the member locker dashboard with navigation cards to five sections: Bills, Equipment, Documents, Photos, and Drive Links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (racing-red, carbon-black, metallic-silver, safety-orange, championship-gold), container settings, and animation keyframes for the UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking two pending feature requests to rebrand from 'Baja Club Hub' to 'VVCEBAJA' and change footer text to '#BuiltBeyondBounds', with architectural notes about Internet Identity authentication.
